name: Sorakado Ao
source:
An islander who is friendly to and loved by all, regardless of age or gender. She works at a Japanese sweets shop on the island. 

She is accompanied by a wild fox(?).

She has been known to be found sleeping at various places around the island, but it is something normal to the islanders.

"In any case, leave me alone when I'm asleep."
